user.title: Sign in to ROBAM
user.description: Use the phone number and password of your ROBAM / ROKI account.

devices.title: Select devices
devices.description: Select the appliances to add to Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The session for {phone} expired. Enter the password again.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the ROBAM cloud, try again later
error.invalid_levels: Enter positive levels separated by commas, for example 1,2,3,6

abort.no_supported_devices: No supported appliance was found on this account (it must be powered and online)

draft_profile.name: Draft a profile
draft_profile.description: Create a profile draft and fixture from the cached device properties; a recent learning session adds ready-to-test controls. No command is sent to the appliance and no cloud request is made.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Pick a ROBAM ROKI device from the device registry (mutually exclusive with guid).

guid.name: Device GUID
guid.description: Target a device by GUID (mutually exclusive with device_id; rarely needed).

write_fixture.name: Write a fixture
write_fixture.description: Also save a regression fixture for the draft (default on).

learn_start.name: Start learning a device
learn_start.description: Passively record the commands the official App sends to this device for up to ten minutes. No command is sent to the appliance.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Device to learn (mutually exclusive with guid).

guid.name: Device GUID
guid.description: Target a device by GUID (mutually exclusive with device_id).

learn_stop.name: Stop learning
learn_stop.description: Finish the current learning session and return the recorded actions and observed property changes.

device_id.name: Device (optional)
device_id.description: Check that the session belongs to this device.

export_profile.name: Export profile (.md)
export_profile.description: Combine the active user profile and its fixture into one Markdown file (five sections, two marker blocks) that can be pasted into a GitHub issue or a PR. Only the .md is written: no yaml/json, and no command is sent to the appliance.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Pick a ROBAM ROKI device from the device registry (or give guid instead).

guid.name: Device GUID
guid.description: Give the device GUID directly (alternative to device_id, rarely needed).

profile_parse_failed.title: Profile cannot be parsed
profile_parse_failed.description:
The file {path} could not be loaded: {error}

This issue disappears automatically once the file is fixed.

profile_conflict.title: Profile match conflict
profile_conflict.description:
The device {device} (dc={dc}) is matched equally well by several profiles: {profiles}.

Make one match more specific (for example add dt) or remove the extra files.

unverified_controls_enabled.title: Unverified controls are allowed
unverified_controls_enabled.description:
The allow-unverified-controls option is on: unverified commands from learning mode or a hand-written profile become real entities and may act unexpectedly on the appliance.

Check each one against the official App, then set verified to true in the profile and turn this option off.

data.countdown_auto_off: Turn the hood off when the countdown ends (the appliance itself only beeps)

learn.title: 1. Learn a new device control

draft.title: 2. Generate a draft
draft.description:
{learned}

Picking a device generates a draft- profile (an existing file is never overwritten: the new one gets -2/-3), then asks how to apply it.

draft_confirm.title: Draft written, confirm the next step

data.enable_unverified_controls: Enable "allow unverified controls" and reload now (affects other devices)
data.reload_now: Reload Home Assistant integrations now so the draft takes effect

draft_confirm_enabled.title: Draft written, confirm the next step

data.reload_now: Reload Home Assistant integrations now so the draft takes effect

export.title: 3. Export a contribution package
export.description: Picking a device merges the active user profile and its fixture into one Markdown file (no yaml/json is written); the persistent notification gives the path.

cleanup.title: 4. Clean up drafts

error.invalid_levels: Enter positive levels separated by commas, for example 1,2,3,6

abort.learn_started: Learning started: operate the feature in the official App now. A session ends by itself after at most 600 seconds, or stop it here early.
abort.learn_stopped: Learning finished with {count} action(s). Go back to the menu and choose "2. Generate a draft".
abort.learn_failed: The learning action failed: another session may be running; see the Home Assistant log.
abort.draft_failed: Could not generate the draft: check that the integration is loaded and the device has cached properties; see the Home Assistant log.
abort.draft_enabled: "Allow unverified controls" was enabled and the integration reloaded: the draft {file} is active.
abort.draft_written: The draft {file} was written: reload the integration manually to see the entities.
abort.export_done: Export finished: the path is in the persistent notification. Paste that .md into /issues/new?template=device_support.yml or open a PR.
abort.export_no_profile: This device has no user profile yet: use "2. Generate a draft" first.
abort.export_builtin: This device is already covered by a built-in profile: open an issue describing the problem instead of exporting.
abort.export_failed: Export failed; see the Home Assistant log.
abort.drafts_removed: Removed {drafts} draft(s), {fixtures} fixture(s) and {exports} export bundle(s). If any button entity became unavailable, delete it from Settings → Entities.
abort.drafts_kept: Nothing was ticked, so nothing was deleted.
